data.content_ref: inline:Model warrant status as the least fixed point of a monotone operator over a free idempotent semiring whose elements are minimal attacker constellations. The grounded extension is the image under a homomorphism that maps nonempty constellations to UNDECIDED. This makes the suspension boundary an algebraic invariant rather than a post-hoc diagnostic, and yields polynomial algorithms via semiring path problems. Criticizable: semiring operations may not capture defense depth unless the carrier is chosen carefully; the polynomiality claim depends on the semiring satisfying distributivity.
